[[File:Rutiger.jpg|thumb]]
The '''rutiger tree''' was a [[Tree/Legends|tree]] found on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="TPM junior">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (junior novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' junior novelization]]</ref> It was imported to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]]. The tree grew in swamp conditions, but was very delicate, because its roots had a limited depth range. The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] used the tree's sap in their weaving process of the [[saago grass]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
